candidate.scope: Assigned lower sci-DNA-Seq row: single-cell combinatorial indexed DNA sequencing with the depicted SDS/crosslinking nucleosome-depletion preparation, corresponding to the xSDS SCI-seq implementation supported by Vitak et al. (PMID 28135258). The three parallel wells in each indexing round are repeated compartments, not alternative methods. SCI-seq is the supporting paper’s name for this architecture; no separate grouped target is introduced. LAND is a paper-only alternative and is outside the depicted preparation. The partially visible LIANTI row above is adjacent context with no route into sci-DNA-Seq. The cell-to-DNA inset identifies the target; it is not a separate DNA-extraction transfer into the nuclei route. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete laboratory protocol.

features: The final DNA icon shows short genomic fragments with colored terminal segments representing combined index histories.
